neighbours.label: the determiner that opens the standard of comparison after a comparative of degree ('bigger than [the]', 'longer than [a]', 'outweighs [the]', 'exceeds [the]'); the + pole fires on 'than' itself
fire: The river here is much wider than the stream behind our house.
A blue whale is heavier than a herd of elephants.
Sales this spring exceeded the total for all of last year.
The tower stands taller than the cathedral beside it.
Her second novel sold better than the first.
The moon appears brighter than the stars around it.
In winter the nights are far longer than the days.
The cost of repairs outweighs the value of the car.
quiet: The river here runs past the stream behind our house.
A blue whale was spotted near a herd of dolphins.
Sales this spring followed the pattern of last year.
The tower stands beside the cathedral in the square.
Her second novel resembles the first in many ways.
The moon appears among the stars around midnight.
In winter the nights are cold and the days are short.
Unlike the old car, the new one starts on cold mornings.

notes: Probe: 'than the/a' 0.42-0.58, 'outweighs the' 0.66, 'exceeds the' 0.46; 'Unlike the' 0.03, 'similar to the' 0.05, 'differs from the' 0.09, plain ' the' 0.03.
